description: This is a unit test class for the ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategy, testing its behavior with various scenarios involving FeatureDefinitions within a Thing object.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategy, verifying behavior under various feature modification scenarios.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static test data like feature ID and a modified feature definition.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares a new instance of ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: modifyFeatureDefinitionOfThingWithoutFeatures
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to modify a feature definition on a thing that has no features.

methods.name: modifyFeatureDefinitionOfThingWithoutThatFeature
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to modify a feature definition that doesn't exist on the thing.

methods.name: modifyFeatureDefinitionOfFeatureWithoutDefinition
methods.description: Tests behavior when modifying a feature's definition when the feature exists but lacks a definition.

methods.name: modifyExistingFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Tests successful modification of an existing feature's definition.
